summary: [spec-fidelity] The brief's F1 order and F6 ask the implementer to leave (a) the hash of the schema/errors/warnings/schemas/command outputs of the crate-only build (crate 0.3.0, constant 1.5, 320fcb199) against the parent build, and (b) the checker's report summary and run time, in evidence. Neither is in any evidence record: claim16.03 holds only the 0.40.0-vs-final comparison; the run summary is only in the commit message of 0d3e10466 (74 MUST passed, 4m09s), while the CHANGELOG says 5 min 46 s. The CHANGELOG nevertheless states as fact that the crate-only build prints the same bytes. I reproduced both: a build of 320fcb199 prints 190 answers (tree per role, 27 groups, 78 commands, --schemas, --errors, --warnings) byte-identical to the 0.40.0 binary with no substitution; atip check --level L2 --contract 1.6 --deep (checker 0.3.0) on the final binary gives 'L2 met: 74 MUST passed, 0 MUST failed, 0 MUST unprovided, 8 not applicable, 1 SHOULD advisories' (L1.one-meaning-values for --kind; L1.depth, L1.one-meaning, L0.contract-version pass; L1.comma-list not applicable), 8m14s on this loaded machine. Fix: attach the stage-1 comparison and the checker report to evidence (claim16.01/.03/.11), and make the CHANGELOG time and the commit message agree or drop the time. Blast radius: nothing else in the checks reads the crate-only stage.
